title: The Smell of the Sea
paragraphs: Setelah bertahun-tahun tinggal di pedalaman untuk bekerja, Hakim akhirnya mengunjungi pesisir lagi selama liburan singkat, dan begitu ia keluar dari mobil, aroma laut yang akrab langsung mengingatkannya pada kenangan masa kecil. Istrinya, yang tumbuh di pedalaman dan jarang melihat laut, memperhatikannya dengan seksama, penasaran mengapa aroma sesederhana itu tampak memengaruhinya begitu dalam setelah sekian lama tidak kembali.

Hakim menjelaskan bahwa ia menghabiskan setiap musim panas masa kecilnya di pantai persis ini bersama kakek neneknya, dan aroma itu saja membawa lebih banyak kenangan daripada foto apa pun baginya. Berjalan menyusuri pantai bersama malam itu, istrinya akhirnya memahami mengapa ia bersikeras melakukan perjalanan ini. Beberapa tempat, ia sadari, menyimpan kenangan begitu kuat sehingga kembali terasa seperti bertemu sahabat lama.
answerKey: After years of living inland for work, Hakim finally visits the coast again during a short holiday, and the moment he steps out of the car, the familiar smell of the sea instantly brings back childhood memories. His wife, who grew up inland and has rarely seen the ocean, watches him closely, curious why such a simple smell seems to affect him so deeply after all these years away. Hakim explains that he spent every summer of his childhood at this exact beach with his grandparents, and the smell alone carries more memories than any photograph ever could for him. Walking along the shore together that evening, his wife finally understands why he insisted on this trip. Some places, she realizes, hold memories so strongly that returning feels like meeting an old friend.
